# CASE py_list_comprehension_await expect=fire
async def a(items):
    return [await save(item) for item in items]


# CASE py_dict_comprehension_await expect=fire
async def b(items):
    return {item: await load(item) for item in items}


# CASE py_while_index expect=fire
async def c(items):
    i = 0
    while i < len(items):
        await save(items[i])
        i += 1


# CASE py_while_pop expect=fire
async def d(items):
    queue = list(items)
    while queue:
        item = queue.pop()
        await save(item)


# CASE py_wait_for expect=fire
async def e(items):
    for item in items:
        await asyncio.wait_for(save(item), 5)


# CASE py_enumerate expect=fire
async def f(items):
    for index, item in enumerate(items):
        await save(index, item)


# CASE py_executor expect=fire
async def g(loop, items):
    for item in items:
        await loop.run_in_executor(None, work, item)


# CASE py_set_comprehension_await expect=fire
async def h(items):
    return {await load(item) for item in items}


# CASE end expect=pass
